skill.name: baoyu-slide-deck
skill.description: Generate professional slide deck images from source content. The skill builds a structured outline, creates style-specific slide prompts, and can generate image files for each slide.
skill.summary: Create structured presentation outlines and slide images from articles, notes, or pasted content.
skill.author: JimLiu

security_audit.summary: The static external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks in documentation and examples. The system reconnaissance findings are design or writing instructions, not reconnaissance behavior. A high-severity semantic issue remains because the base image prompt tells the generator not to refuse sensitive or copyrighted figure requests.

remediation.issue: Unsafe refusal override in the base image prompt.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the instruction that says not to refuse generation. Tell the model to follow platform safety rules and use safe alternatives only when allowed.

remediation.issue: External image generation is delegated to a separate workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the baoyu-gemini-web dependency and require user confirmation before sending source-derived prompts to an external image service.

static_findings.snippet: Blueprint style, schematic diagrams, grid layouts
| `--outline-only` | Generate outline only, skip image generation |
| `retro-flat` | Flat vector illustration with retro palette |
When no `--style` is specified, analyze content for style signals:
| AI, coding, tech, digital, algorithm, data | `technical` |
| Simple, zen, focus, essential, one idea | `minimal` |
| Wellness, healing, cozy, self-care, lifestyle, comfort | `warm` |
| Tutorial, explainer, how-to, beginner, product, guide | `retro-flat` |
| Knowledge, concept, productivity, SaaS, notion, intellectual | `notion` |
| `experts` | Dense information, technical depth, less hand-holding |
| `executives` | High-level insights, key metrics, strategic focus |
| `general` | Accessible language, broad appeal, clear takeaways |
Create outline with `STYLE_INSTRUCTIONS` block and slide specifications.
Save outline as `outline.md` in target directory.
If `--outline-only` flag is set, stop here.
- Avoid AI-generated clichés ("It wasn't just X, it was Y")

content.user_title: Create Slide Deck Images From Content
content.value_statement: Turning long content into a consistent visual deck takes planning and prompt writing. This skill creates a structured outline, slide prompts, and generated slide images.
actual_capabilities: Creates a slide deck outline with source, style, audience, language, and slide count.
Selects a visual style from content signals when no style is provided.
Supports presets such as corporate, technical, playful, minimal, warm, and notion.
Writes per-slide prompt files with layout, color, text, and visual direction.
Can generate slide images sequentially through the configured image generation workflow.
Can stop after the outline when the outline-only option is used.
limitations: Image generation depends on the separate baoyu-gemini-web workflow being available.
Generated slide text and imagery still need human review before publishing.
Decks are capped at 20 slides by the skill instructions.
The skill is optimized for reading and sharing, not live speaker notes.

use_cases.title: Turn Articles Into Shareable Decks
use_cases.description: Convert a long article into a structured visual deck with consistent slide prompts and images.

use_cases.title: Prepare Executive Briefings
use_cases.description: Transform strategy notes into a concise deck with business framing and audience-specific emphasis.

use_cases.title: Explain Technical Concepts
use_cases.description: Create diagram-focused slides for tutorials, research summaries, or engineering walkthroughs.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Basic Deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a slide deck from the pasted content. Use the default style and generate the outline and images.

prompt_templates.title: Set Audience And Language
prompt_templates.scenario: Add basic controls for audience and language.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a slide deck from this article for beginners. Use English and keep the visuals clear and simple.

prompt_templates.title: Build Outline Only
prompt_templates.scenario: Review the deck structure before image generation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an outline-only slide deck from my report. Use the technical style and target 12 slides.

prompt_templates.title: Generate An Executive Deck
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with style, audience, and narrative constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a corporate slide deck from this strategy memo for executives. Use 10 slides, narrative headlines, and image prompts for every slide.

output_examples.input: A founder memo about a new AI product launch.
output_examples.output: A 10-slide corporate deck with a cover, market context, product value, launch plan, risks, and closing slide.

output_examples.input: A technical article about vector databases.
output_examples.output: A blueprint-style deck with schematic diagrams, data flow slides, and concise explanations for engineering readers.

output_examples.input: A wellness essay about better sleep habits.
output_examples.output: A warm illustrated deck with calm colors, practical steps, and a meaningful closing message.

best_practices: Provide source content with clear sections, facts, and desired audience.
Choose a style preset when brand tone matters.
Review generated images for text accuracy before sharing.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a factual research tool without source material.
Do not request more than 20 slides in one deck.
Do not publish generated slides without checking names, data, and policy-sensitive imagery.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a deck outline, per-slide prompt files, and slide images when image generation is enabled.

faq.question: Can I choose a visual style?
faq.answer: Yes. You can request presets such as corporate, technical, playful, minimal, warm, retro-flat, or notion.

faq.question: Can it make only an outline?
faq.answer: Yes. Use an outline-only request when you want to review structure before generating images.

faq.question: Does it support different audiences?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes presets for beginners, intermediate readers, experts, executives, and general audiences.

faq.question: Does it verify facts?
faq.answer: No. It relies on the source content and should not be used as a research or fact-checking tool.

faq.question: What should I review before publishing?
faq.answer: Review text accuracy, visual consistency, source attribution, and any policy-sensitive images.
